name: KIFS Financial Services Limited
about: KIFS Financial Services Limited operates as a non-banking financial and investment and credit company in India. It provides capital market products, including margin trading, loans against shares and securities, funding market issues for the retail investors, IPO and FPO funding, and other products. The company was formerly known as Khandwala Capital Services Limited. KIFS Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. KIFS Financial Services Limited is a subsidiary of Khandwala Commercial Private Limited.
